paite: Migilou kuamah delh louh in atai; himahleh midiktat humpinelkai bang in ahangsan hi.
english: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

paite: Gam tatlekna ziak in thuneimi tampi a-om a; himahleh theisiam leh theihna nei mite ziak in huai gam bel suk vaiveng theih ahi.
english: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.

paite: Taksap hau migenthei nuaisiahte zaw lou susia vuahpi zu bang ahi.
english: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.

paite: Amau dan mangngilhte'n migilou aphat ua; himahleh huchibang dan zuite amau tung ah athangpai uhi.
english: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.

paite: Mihoih lou in vaihawmna atheisiam kei; himahleh amau TOUPA zongte'n thil tengteng atheisiam uh.
english: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek Yahweh understand it fully.

paite: Alampite a hoih lou mihau sang in athutakna a om migenthei ahoihzaw hi.
english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.

paite: Kuapeuh dan zui tapa pil ahi; himahleh kuapeuh anhai mite toh kithuah in apa azumsak hi.
english: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.

paite: Kuapeuh aneih, anou leh apung tamsak in, migenthei hehpihmi amah a ding in alakhawm hi.
english: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.

paite: Kuapeuh dan za lou ding a abil kaihei, athumna nangawn kihhuai ahi.
english: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.

paite: Kuapeuh lampi gilou a midik lamhaihsak, ama kokhuk mahmah ah akelut ding hi; himahleh mihoihkim in gou hoih aluah ding hi.
english: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.

paite: Mihausa ama ngaih in apil a; himahleh migenthei theihsiamna nei in amah azongkhia hi.
english: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.

paite: Midiktat avualzoh chiang in, thupina lian a-om; himahleh migilou athoh chiang in, mite abu uhi.
english: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.

paite: Kuapeuh atatlekna khuh alohching kei ding; himahleh kuapeuh huaite thupha tawi a, mangngilh in zahngaihna amu ding uh.
english: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

paite: Lau thei gige mi ahampha hi; himahleh alungtang saksak gige siatna ah ake ding hi.
english: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.

paite: Humpinelkai humham leh vompi hawk bang in; huai mah bang in migentheite tung a vaihawmmi gilou ahi.
english: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.

paite: Vaihawmmi theihsiamna tasam nuaisiah hat mithupi ahi; himahleh kuapeuh huaihamna hua in anite asausak ding hi.
english: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.

paite: Mi kuapeuh sisan a dimmi himhim, kokhuk sung ah atailut ding; kuamah in panpih kei hen.
english: A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him.

paite: Kuapeuh tangtak a om suahtaksak in a-om ding; himahleh kuapeuh alampite a hoih lou apuk zaw ding hi.
english: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.

paite: Kuapeuh agam lei let in tanghou tampi anei ding; himahleh kuapeuh mi bangmah lou nungzui in gentheihna kiching anei ding hi.
english: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.

paite: Miginom in vualzawlna ahau ding; himahleh kuapeuh hau ding a kintat gawt louh in a-om kei ding hi.
english: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.

paite: Mite deihsak tuam neih ahoih kei; tanghou them ziak in mi atalek ding leng ahi sam kei hi.
english: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.

paite: Kuapeuh deihgawl sumchit hauhsakna delh in akinoh a, huan atung ah taksapna ahong tung sin chih athei kei hi.
english: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.

paite: Kuapeuh mi deihsakna a sal in alei a maitangphat hatmi sang in deihsakna tamsem anung in amu ding hi.
english: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.

paite: Kuapeuh anu hiam apa hiam lok a, "Tatlekna ahi kei," chimi zaw; amah mah hihsemi kithuahpih ahi hi.
english: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.

paite: Kuapeuh lungsim duhgawl in kinakna atokthou hi; himahleh kuapeuh TOUPA a muanna koih thausak in a-om ding hi.
english: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in Yahweh will prosper.

paite: Kuapeuh ama lungtang muang mihai ahi; himahleh kuapeuh piltak a om, suahtaksak in a-om ding hi.
english: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.

paite: Kuapeuh genthei kiang a pia atasam kei ding a; himahleh kuapeuh amit sel in hamsia tampi anei ding hi.
english: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.

paite: Migiloute alal chiang un, mite akibu ua; himahleh amanthat chiang un, midiktat apung hi.
english: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.
